name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response aligns with the given context and interesting fact.

name: Clarity
description: Assesses the clarity of expression and how easily the response can be understood by others.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the ability of the response to capture interest and provoke further interaction or conversation.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response, considering how unique or novel it is.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and consistency of the response, ensuring that ideas are connected and make sense together.

name: Emotion
description: Evaluates the emotional resonance of the response, considering how well it conveys feelings or evokes an emotional reaction.

name: Conciseness
description: Measures how succinctly ideas are expressed without unnecessary verbosity while maintaining meaning.
